description: Learn a bigram language model from an observed CORPUS, as graph data. The agent observes a stream of transition tokens (Obs --prev--> Concept(a), --cur--> Concept(b)) and a Bigram skeleton (Bigram --from--> a, --to--> b; a --has_outbg--> Bigram). tally_bigram joins each new Obs to its Bigram through the shared symbols and tallies it as a DISTINCT edge (no shared counter to race on). count_bigram materialises count = Count(tallied); total_from sums a's outgoing counts; bigram_logp normalises to a smoothed log-probability logp = log(count+a) - log(total+a*A). The learned LM is then graph data (Bigram.logp) the decode reads. All counting/normalisation is Rules; the host only streams the corpus and reads logp back.

microtheory.name: lm_learn
microtheory.description: count corpus bigrams and normalise to a log-prob LM, graph-native
